question: Which types of races fit me best?
note: Drafted against the exact prompt this request produces, pending a live re-record with `npm run record:demo`.

response.answer:
Cool races suit you best. Both of your strength verdicts came in cold or cool conditions, Tunkhannock Trail 50K at 6°C on singletrack and Lakefront 10K at 14°C on road, averaging 10°C, while your only limiter, Brandywine Valley Marathon, came at 27°C. Those two are also your top results by percentile: 98.6 at Lakefront and 95.2 at Tunkhannock.

Temperature separates your results more clearly than distance or surface does. You've posted strengths on both a 10km road race and a 50km trail race, and your two road races split 1 strength and 1 limiter, with heat the clear difference between them. Gravel is the open question: Hollow Road Gravel Classic is your only ride and came out mixed at 11°C, so one race isn't enough to say whether cycling suits you.
